notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.1 116
notes.content:
Improvements
Added AI difficulty levels : Easy, Medium, Hard

Lower difficulty level means that the AI will be less accurate in what it does

Before the AI always played at the Hard level

Now Medium level will be default

Easy level won't use dashing

AI Difficulty toggle has been added to the options and the level selection screen

AI now better handles situations when the ball is at the level bounds

AI now will be more random on how it plays for variety

AI now guards teleporter exits better
Mechanics
Raised the default ball gravity up by 10% to improve the gameplay dynamic

Ball-jumps now makes the ball also inherit the character x velocity

Ball-jumps now make the character jump at 60% of total jump power instead of 100%

Ball-jumps now apply 40% more force to the ball
Characters
Rescaled all characters jumping, which is now higher, but they also fall faster

Raised all characters movement, which is now 10% more quick

Penguin 

Raised dash speed from 22 to 23

Giraffe

Lowered dash speed from 22 to 21

Dragon

Raised movement speed by 10%

Raised jump cooldown from 0.3 to 0.34s
Other
Lowered the UI bobbing amount by 30%

Updated localization files

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.0 112
notes.content:
Bugfixes
Fixed wavy floor having no shadows.

Fixed demo localization.

Fixed resolution refresh rate rendering sometimes being bad.

Fixed localization in the level selection screen.
Improvements
Level selection screen now remembers the last level selection.

Demo version now has a new character in a rotation system, meaning that a character has been added to the previous 3 demo characters, giving a total of 4 characters available in the demo. 

During this update this character is Dragon. 

The rotation character will change in future updates every once in a while.

Unlocked characters will still be unlocked when they get into rotation again.
Mechanics
Raised the default ball gravity up by 12.5% to improve the gameplay dynamic.
Other
Added FishNet logo.

Updated localization files.
